newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to help industry to boost exports - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to help industry to boost exports - report.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce will begin discussing on Monday measures to help at least 15 industrial sectors boost exports and cope with foreign competition, newspapers reported on Monday.
The measures would include ways to facilitate the industry's access to credit lines and reduce the so-called Brazil cost, O Globo newspaper said.
Fifteen areas identified as in need of some help include capital goods, steel, electronics, autoparts, agricultural machinery, toys, textile, civil construction, pulp and paper and fishing.
Last week, the government announced a record trade deficit of $5.539 billion in 1996.
